purpose: Establish whether the frozen engine has sufficient historical point-in-time data for a full backtest before any re-estimation or threshold tuning.

macro.coverage: Broad 2016-2026 observation histories exist in archived MACRO_SERIES; coverage differs by series/currency.
macro.blocker: Histories are current-revised observations, not release-date vintages; publication timing and first-release values are not fully reconstructed.
macro.implication: Usable for descriptive/pseudo-OOS research, not yet a clean full point-in-time backtest.

rates.coverage: Validated same-basis historical 2Y series for USD, GBP, JPY, CHF, CAD, AUD, NZD.
rates.blocker: EUR historical rates chain remains WITHHELD because legacy history is not certified same-basis with the current validated ECB curve.

cb_ois.blocker: Homogeneous G8 historical point-in-time CB/OIS expectations have not been reconstructed.

cot.blocker: Before inclusion in a full backtest, effective availability must respect CFTC observation-vs-publication lag and historical depth must be verified against the intended sample.

price.coverage: Canonical 28-pair ECB-based price matrix exists and was used in the v9.3 pseudo-OOS reconstruction.
price.blocker: None for price direction itself; execution/cost assumptions remain a separate backtest design item.

liquidity.blocker: NZD historical liquidity replay remains WITHHELD.

limitations: Macro uses current-revised histories rather than release-date vintages.
COT and Liquidity excluded from structural direction in that exercise.
existing_validation.conclusion: This existing test is useful evidence on the frozen hierarchy but is not a substitute for the full historical point-in-time backtest.

must_close_before_full_backtest: Define exact historical sample and required features per layer.
Complete/replace EUR historical Rates or formally exclude EUR-containing pair-years from the full-core test.
Build publication-date/PIT mapping for every macro series used by the engine, with vintage policy documented.
Reconstruct historical CB/OIS expectations to a homogeneous standard or formally remove CB/OIS from the historical core specification.
Verify COT historical depth and enforce publication lag.
Decide whether NZD historical liquidity is completed or excluded from overlay tests.
Run missing/stale/outlier/frequency alignment QA after the historical panel is built.

next_action: Build a currency-by-layer historical inventory with start/end dates, frequency, source, publication lag, vintage status, and ACTIVE/PARTIAL/WITHHELD status. No backtest rerun until this gate passes.
